title: Ian Gillett Font
author: Freebies
description:
Ian Gillett is a modern and playful handwritten script font. It’s great for crafters and designers. It is perfect for any branding project such as logos, t-shirt printing, creative products, or pretty much anything that could benefit from a geometric, fancy vibe. This font is PUA encoded which means you can access all of the glyphs and swashes with ease! 
Created by Kong Font Studio
https://www.creativefabrica.com/designer/fontkong
